issue.title: Maestro playbook + informational CI (workflow_dispatch)
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Parent: #488.

Docs playbook mapping QA checklists → Maestro flows (and residual manual), plus optional **informational** `workflow_dispatch` Android CI — **not** a merge gate. Needs QA? / `@Roslin22` nightly handoff unchanged.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** QA process docs; onboarding says no E2E; no Maestro workflow.

**Expected:** `docs/guides/maestro.md` + links from QA/onboarding/ci; manual Actions smoke with secrets + artifacts.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Playbook: eng vs QA how-to-run; journey → flow map; residual manual (exploratory, hardware, uncovered)
- Update AGENT_ONBOARDING / qa-process links when harness is on `main`
- `.github/workflows/maestro-*.yml` (`workflow_dispatch` only; schedule off until stable)
- Document secrets (`MAESTRO_EMAIL` / `MAESTRO_PASSWORD`, second account if needed)

**Out of scope:** Required PR checks; replacing nightly human QA; iOS

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `docs/guides/maestro.md` landed with honest residual list
- [ ] Linked from QA docs / onboarding
- [ ] One green manual Actions run recorded (or blocker noted)
- [ ] `docs/ci.md` lists workflow as informational

## Verification / test plan

1. Docs review against landed flows (#491 / #495)
2. Dispatch workflow once smokes exist

## Links

- Refs #488
- Absorbs former CI-only slice

Shipped in https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/509 (merged).

**AC note — green Actions run:** `workflow_dispatch` only registers after the workflow is on the default branch. Dispatching `harness` on `main` next; will follow up with the run URL (or document a blocker if the emulator/build job fails).

**Harness CI blocker (AC: green run or blocker noted)**

Dispatched after merge: https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/actions/runs/34649217854 (`suite=harness`).

- Prebuild + Maestro install succeeded
- **Failed** at `Build APK + run Maestro on emulator` (exit 2) — no `app-release.apk` / test_output artifacts produced
- Likely Gradle `assembleRelease` (or emulator-runner script) on `ubuntu-latest`; needs a follow-up ticket to stabilize informational CI (signing/SDK/emulator). Cron remains off until then.

Playbook + workflow are on `main` via #509; local Maestro path unchanged.
